title: The Defeat of Gog and the Restoration of Israel

questions.question: God continues His prophecy against Gog, saying He will bring him up from the uttermost parts of the north. What does God predict He will strike from Gog's hands?
options: God will strike his bow from his left hand and make his arrows drop from his right hand
God will strike his sword and shield from his grasp
God will shatter the axle of his chariot
God will break the reins of his horses
questions.correctAnswer: God will strike his bow from his left hand and make his arrows drop from his right hand
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:3 (ESV): "Then I will strike your bow from your left hand, and will make your arrows drop out of your right hand."

questions.question: Where will Gog and all his hordes fall?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:4 (ESV): "You shall fall on the mountains of Israel, you and all your hordes and the peoples who are with you."

questions.question: To whom will God give Gog as food?
options: To birds of prey of every sort and to the beasts of the field
To the poor and destitute of Israel
To the fish of the Mediterranean sea
To the worms of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: To birds of prey of every sort and to the beasts of the field
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:4 (ESV): "I will give you to birds of prey of every sort and to the beasts of the field to be devoured."

questions.question: God says He will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely where?
options: Within the walled cities of the east
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:6 (ESV): "I will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the coastlands, and they shall know that I am the Lord."

questions.question: What will the house of Israel NEVER do again, according to God's promise in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:7 (ESV): "And my holy name I will make known in the midst of my people Israel, and I will not let my holy name be profaned anymore."

questions.question: In the aftermath of Gog's defeat, what will the inhabitants of the cities of Israel go out and make fires with?
options: The weapons: shields, bucklers, bows, arrows, clubs, and spears
The bones of the slain out of necessity
questions.correctAnswer: The weapons: shields, bucklers, bows, arrows, clubs, and spears
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:9 (ESV): "...will go out and make fires of the weapons and burn them, shields and bucklers, bow and arrows, clubs and spears..."

questions.question: How long will they use the weapons to make fires instead of gathering wood from the field?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:9 (ESV): "...and they will make fires of them for seven years,"

questions.question: Where will God provide a place for the burial of Gog in Israel?
options: The Valley of the Travelers, east of the sea
The Valley of Hinnom, outside Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: The Valley of the Travelers, east of the sea
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:11 (ESV): "On that day I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers, east of the sea."

questions.question: What new name will that place be called once Gog and all his multitude are buried there?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:11 (ESV): "It will block the travelers, for there Gog and all his multitude will be buried. It will be called the Valley of Hamon-gog."

questions.question: How many months will it take for the house of Israel to bury Gog's army in order to cleanse the land?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:12 (ESV): "For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them, in order to cleanse the land."

questions.question: If a traveler sees a human bone after the seven months, what must he do until the buriers have buried it?
options: Set up a sign by it
Report it to the priests in Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: Set up a sign by it
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:15 (ESV): "And when anyone sees a human bone, then he shall set up a sign by it, until the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog."

questions.question: What sacrificial feast does God tell the son of man to call the birds and beasts to?
options: "Assemble and come, gather from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great sacrificial feast on the mountains of Israel, and you shall eat flesh and drink blood."
"A feast of unleavened bread in the desert."
"A feast of wine on the lees, well refined."
questions.correctAnswer: "Assemble and come, gather from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great sacrificial feast on the mountains of Israel, and you shall eat flesh and drink blood."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:17 (ESV): "...Assemble and come, gather from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great sacrificial feast on the mountains of Israel, and you shall eat flesh and drink blood."

questions.question: Whose flesh and blood specifically will the birds and beasts eat and drink at this feast?
options: The flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth—of rams, of lambs, and of he-goats, of bulls, all of them fat beasts of Bashan
The flesh of Kings David and Solomon
The blood of the false prophets of Baal
questions.correctAnswer: The flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth—of rams, of lambs, and of he-goats, of bulls, all of them fat beasts of Bashan
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:18 (ESV): "You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth—of rams, of lambs, and of he-goats, of bulls, all of them fat beasts of Bashan."

questions.question: When the nations see this, what will they finally understand about why the house of Israel went into captivity?
options: That the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they dealt so treacherously with God that He hid His face from them
That God was weaker than the gods of Babylon
That it was an arbitrary test of their faith
That the prophets had lied to them
questions.correctAnswer: That the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they dealt so treacherously with God that He hid His face from them
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:23 (ESV): "And the nations shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they dealt so treacherously with me that I hid my face from them and gave them into the hand of their adversaries..."

questions.question: At the end of the chapter, what does God promise regarding the restoration of Israel?
options: "I will leave none of them remaining among the nations anymore. And I will not hide my face from them anymore, for I shall pour out my Spirit upon the house of Israel."
"I will bring back exactly one third of the exiles."
"I will make them rulers over Babylon."
"I will destroy the earth by flood, but save them in an ark."
questions.correctAnswer: "I will leave none of them remaining among the nations anymore. And I will not hide my face from them anymore, for I shall pour out my Spirit upon the house of Israel."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 39:28-29 (ESV): "...then I will gather them to their own land. I will leave none of them remaining among the nations anymore. And I will not hide my face from them anymore, for I shall pour out my Spirit upon the house of Israel, declares the Lord God."

key_verse_text: "And I will not hide my face from them anymore, for I shall pour out my Spirit upon the house of Israel, declares the Lord God."
